# Registry catalog fixtures

Copied verbatim from Modules commit `e9f08e4fdc934567fa0d2c4979f07773a4180aa8`,
`proto-contracts/livepeer/registry/v1/testdata/`. These are informational protobuf
catalogs, not payment authorization fixtures. Estimator fixture references and
payment quote fields may be absent; illustrative settlement IDs are not validated
as payment domains by the discovery parser. Payment route parsing remains strict.
